entry.title: Unsloth: Fine-tuning LLMs easily
entry.summary: This post introduces Unsloth, a framework that simplifies the fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) for specific tasks. It highlights the challenges of fine-tuning LLMs and how Unsloth addresses these issues, making it accessible to a broader audience.
